name: mergeone
description: A merge gateway for agent pull requests: ask the gate before merging, find duplicates before opening a PR; it never merges or closes anything.

MERGEONE_MODEL_KEY.title: Decision-model API key (optional)
MERGEONE_MODEL_KEY.description: Key for the model named in .mergeone.yaml (Typesafe for jev, Perplexity for pplx-flash, Anthropic for haiku). Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY / PERPLEXITY_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from your environment or .env.

MERGEONE_GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token (optional)
MERGEONE_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Lets gate_similar and mergeone pr read pull requests from GitHub. Leave empty to use GITHUB_TOKEN from your environment.
